# truenas_kerberos_config (Resource)

Manages the TrueNAS Kerberos configuration (kerberos.config) — the [appdefaults]/[libdefaults] free-form additions to krb5.conf. This is a singleton resource — there is exactly one Kerberos configuration per TrueNAS system, so it is never created or deleted on TrueNAS; Terraform create/update calls kerberos.update, and Terraform delete only removes the resource from state (the configuration is left in place).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# System Kerberos configuration — SINGLETON. Declare at most one per config.
resource "truenas_kerberos_config" "config" {
  libdefaults_aux = "forwardable = true"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `appdefaults_aux` (String) Advanced field for manually setting additional parameters inside the appdefaults section of krb5.conf. Generally not required — the necessary krb5.conf settings are automatically detected and set for the environment. See the MIT krb5.conf manpage.
- `libdefaults_aux` (String) Advanced field for manually setting additional parameters inside the libdefaults section of krb5.conf. Generally not required — the necessary krb5.conf settings are automatically detected and set for the environment. See the MIT krb5.conf manpage.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton resource: always "kerberos_config".
